concept.title: Children's clubs, childcare and SEND support
concept.shortdesc: Clubs, sessions, childcare and support for babies, children and young people, including after-school and youth groups, nurseries, toddler groups and help for children with special needs.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Support, learning help, resources and information for children and young people with special educational needs, disabilities or conditions such as autism, ADHD, dyslexia or learning disabilities.
: Clubs and sessions that school-age children attend after the school day, such as after-school clubs, homework clubs and evening sessions.
: Regular clubs, groups and sessions for young people to meet, play and take part in activities together, including junior and senior youth clubs and youth councils.
: Sessions where children take part in sensory play and activities, such as sensory rooms, sensory stories, messy play and multi-sensory groups.
: Regular drop-in sessions where babies, toddlers and pre-schoolers play and socialise together with their parents, grandparents or carers.
: Paid or funded care for children while parents are away, including childminders, day care, creches and funded childcare places.
: Attending a nursery for care and early education, including day nurseries, maintained nurseries and funded nursery places for under-fives.
